title: Transitivity of geometric irreducibility
statement: Let $k\subseteq L\subseteq K$ be a tower of fields [def-pc-field-extension]. If $L/k$ is geometrically irreducible and $K/L$ is geometrically irreducible [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], then $K/k$ is geometrically irreducible.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: apply AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIrreducible.comp (Irreducible.lean:124--130) to f : Spec K -> Spec L and g : Spec L -> Spec k induced by the tower maps. The two hypotheses are exactly geometric irreducibility as defined in def-pc-geometrically-irreducible (the Mathlib class is Irreducible.lean:42--43). The additional UniversallyOpen instances are inferred by AlgebraicGeometry.instUniversallyOpenOfIsIntegralOfSubsingletonCarrierCarrierCommRingCat, Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/UniversallyOpen.lean:151--176, since Spec L and Spec k are integral subsingletons (integrality instance: Properties.lean:331, from IsDomain of a field; subsingleton from the instance Unique (Spec (.of K)) for a field K, Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Scheme.lean:627--628). The composite is the structure map Spec K -> Spec k by functoriality of Spec and compatibility of the field tower. No finite-degree, separability, finite-type or characteristic restriction is added.
